claim: A toggle property set at two levels of the style hierarchy combines by XOR, not by override: a bold style based on a bold style renders not bold.

sources.locator: wml.xsd CT_OnOff/@w:val is ST_OnOff, so 0/false/off is an explicit "not set" distinct from an absent element; the XOR combination is prose only

fixtures.assertion: A paragraph in Heading1 renders not bold, because Normal's w:b and Heading1's w:b cancel.
